Below is a set of minimal *SEARCH/REPLACE* edits to add first-class “icon-only” support to both the classic (`packages/react/src/components/Tab/Tab.js`) and the “next” tabs (`packages/react/src/components/Tab/next/Tab.js` and `ContainedTab.js`).  In each case we

• introduce a new `renderIcon` prop  
• add it to `propTypes`  
• wire it into the fallback `<button>` so that when only an icon is provided we render that instead of `label`  

You will still need to supply the corresponding CSS (`&__nav-link__icon`, `--icon-only` modifiers, width:48px centering, etc.) in your stylesheets; these JS changes simply enable the prop and output the correct markup.
